# Data Integrity, Security/Privacy and Search Checklist: Course Ratings and Written Reviews

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for the rating summary's consistency, who may do what with reviews, what is exposed publicly, and how ratings drive search
**Created**: 2026-11-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Data Integrity

- [ ] CHK001 Is "one review per student per course" stated for concurrent requests as well as sequential ones? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified which writes change the summary (create, edit rating, delete, removal) and that each does so in the same transaction as the review? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the outcomes of racing writes (edit vs delete, edit vs removal, two edits) defined for both the loser and the summary? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the invariant's scope complete: summary equals visible tally, uniqueness, rating range, enrolment, removed reviews uncounted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it clear that an instructor response never changes the summary or the edited mark? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the effect of dropping a course, archiving a course and deleting a response on existing reviews stated without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it stated that the rating summary must not disturb the course's own record or its instructor-facing update time? [Gap]

## Security and Privacy

- [ ] CHK008 Is each restricted action (post, edit, delete, respond, remove) tied to exactly one role and a measurable refusal outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-008, §FR-009, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it explicit that an instructor of the course cannot remove reviews and that admin removal is separate from instructor response? [Consistency, Spec US4 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the fields exposed publicly enumerated, with email and user ID excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the display-name rule defined for missing names and for later name changes? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the handling of markup and links in review and response text defined? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the abuse-handling scope (no reporting, no queue, no rate limit) stated as intentional? [Assumption, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the removal reason's visibility rules defined (author and admin only, not public)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]

- [ ] CHK023 Is it stated that a rating-changing edit updates the rating summary with a single operation on that record, not two operations on one item in the same transaction? [Clarity, Data Model "Writes by case"]

## Search and Catalogue

- [ ] CHK015 Is the weighted rating defined precisely enough to compute from a count and an average? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the behaviour for unrated courses defined for ordering, boost and filters? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the minimum-rating filter values and the value they compare against (plain average) stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the freshness target for cards and search stated and measurable? [Measurability, Spec SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the interaction with the catalogue filters feature (#333) described, including which of the two changes the search first? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the "no per-card read" requirement for catalogue cards expressed in a testable way? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, SC-006]

## Dependencies and Scope

- [ ] CHK021 Is the dependency on the notifications feature (#331) limited to one optional story, with the behaviour before it exists stated? [Dependency, Spec US5, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the shared need for an admin backend with #333 stated with a rule for who generates it? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
